verdicts.reason: Quote states the declaration style; a coding-style rule, not simulation-checkable (check none ok).
Statement that the RTL has no check is a description of the design (nothing to verify or exercise); not a MUST_NOT requirement.
Permission to use $clog2 is an implementation note with nothing to verify.
Legal range of depth and derivation stated by quote; it is a configuration constraint, check none is fine.
Quote gives range and the width effect; scenario check by exercising widths is reasonable.
Quote states legal values, meanings and same value across modules; scenario check fits.
Quote says option 0 shall not be used for pointer crossings; MUST_NOT is correct, check none is fine as a configuration restriction.
Quote states the 0/1 meaning and that the value comes from SYNC_RST_VAL per bit.
Quote states values and branch selection; the generic macro model is stated.
Quote states range 1 or more and parent sets it to LPARA_PTR_W.
Quote states vector width and per-bit reset value for every stage.

Configuration restriction on the reset value, not observable at interface in simulation; reset-state checkable though. Strength fine but actor/check: configuration constraint with no stimulus beyond default.
Quote lists illegal configurations; restriction on users, MUST_NOT is reasonable.
States that the IP does not check and behaviour is undefined; a description with nothing to verify, and duplicates AF-8-02.

duplicates.reason: Both state that the IP has no illegal-value check (DEC-002).
Option 0 restriction is part of the same CELL_TYPE parameter quote; kept separate only if a distinct constraint is wanted.

questions.question: CELL_TYPE option 1 is 'two D flip-flop cells in series' and option 2 is 'one 2-FF cell', both with S=2. Do they differ in behaviour or only in structure/MTBF?
Illegal configurations list 'stage count outside 2..4', but CELL_TYPE allows 0 (S=0) and no stage-count parameter is defined. What does stage count refer to?
Option 0 (bypass) is legal for CELL_TYPE but must not be used for pointer crossings, where it is the only crossing. Is CELL_TYPE=0 effectively illegal, and what is the behaviour if used?
